verdict.rationale: Fireflies runs some automation in the background on its own: the bot can auto-join calendar meetings to record, transcribe and summarize, with notes and action items delivered after every meeting. Admins also get a 'Rules Engine' of automation workflows, though it is limited to meeting access and privacy. Webhooks, including a Super Admin webhook covering all team meetings, let users trigger downstream workflows, but broader automation relies on external tools like Zapier rather than a native, user-configurable automation builder. Missing for 10: a general-purpose in-product automation/workflow builder, documentation of Rules Engine depth beyond access/privacy, scheduled or agentic autonomous actions beyond meeting capture, independent or hands-on corroboration.
